svg.title: Phone and dashcam on the camera Wi-Fi
svg.desc: OpenBlackVue-Dash on a phone uses HTTP over the dashcam access point to list clips, download them, and open live view. Cloud, NAS, and Termux are outside that path.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The phone joins the dashcam access point. HTTP stays on that link.
